“—”

She moves before I can so much as think, *It can't be.*

Without a moment's hesitation, the knightly girl springs out of the shed.

「！」
体の痛みも忘れ、立ち上がって少女の後を追った。
あの娘があの男に敵う筈がない。
いくらあんな物騒な格好をしていようと、少女は俺より小さな女の子なんだ。

“!”

Forgetting the pain in my body, I force myself upright and run after her.

There is no possible way she can stand against that man.

However dangerous her clothes may look, she is still a girl smaller than I am.

pages.en:
“Stop—!”

The sound swallows the rest of my cry.

“Wha—”

I cannot believe my eyes.

This time, my mind empties so completely that thought itself becomes impossible.

pages.ja:
「なんだ、あいつ
」
響く剣戟。
月は雲に隠れ、庭はもとの闇に戻っている。
その中で火花を散らす鋼と鋼。

pages.en:
“What is she—?”

Steel rings upon steel.

The moon has withdrawn behind the clouds, returning the garden to darkness.

Within it, metal strikes metal and scatters sparks.

pages.ja:
土蔵から飛び出した少女に、槍の男は無言で襲いかかった。
少女は槍を一撃で払いのけ、更に繰り出される槍を弾き返し、その度、男は後退を余儀なくされる。

少女は槍を一撃で払いのけ、更に繰り出される槍を弾き返し、その[ruby text=つど]度、男は後退を余儀なくされる。
pages.en:
The man with the spear attacks the girl the instant she bursts from the shed.

She sweeps aside his first thrust with a single blow, knocks away the spear that follows, and forces him to retreat with every exchange.

pages.ja:
「
」
信じ、られない。
セイバーと名乗った少女は、間違いなくあの男を圧倒していた。

pages.en:
“—”

I cannot believe it.

The girl who called herself Saber is unmistakably overpowering him.

pages.ja:
戦いが、始まった。
先ほどの俺と男のやりとりは戦闘ではない。
戦闘とは、互いを仕留める事ができる能力者同士の争いである。
それがどのような戦力差であろうとも、相手を打倒しうる術があるのなら、それは戦闘と呼べるだろう。

pages.en:
—The battle has begun.

What passed between that man and me was not a battle.

A battle is a contest between opponents who each possess the power to kill the other.

However unequal their strength may be, if both have some means of defeating the other, then the encounter deserves the name.

pages.ja:
そういった意味でも、二人の争いは戦闘だった。
俺では視認する事さえ出来なかった男の槍は、さらに勢いを増して少女へと繰り出される。
それを、
手にした“何か”で確実に弾き逸らし、間髪いれずに間合いへと踏み込む少女。

pages.en:
By that measure, the struggle before me is a true battle.

The man's spear, which I could not even follow before, drives at the girl with still greater force.

She knocks it unerringly aside with the “something” in her hands, then enters his reach without the slightest pause.

pages.ja:

！」
憎々しげに舌打ちをこぼし、男は僅かに後退する。
手にした槍を縦に構え、狙われたであろう脇腹を防ぎに入る
！

！
pages.en:
“Tch—!”

The man clicks his tongue in fury and edges back a fraction.

He raises the spear vertically, moving to guard the flank she must be targeting—!

pages.ja:
「ぐっ……！」
一瞬、男の槍に光が灯った。
爆薬を叩き付けるような一撃は、真実その通りなのだろう。
少女が振るう“何か”を受けた瞬間、男の槍は感電したかのように光を帯びる。
それがなんであるか、男はおろか俺にだって見て取れた。

pages.en:
“Ghh…!”

For an instant, light flares along the man's spear.

The girl's blow lands like a charge of explosives—and perhaps that is no metaphor.

The moment his spear receives the “something” she wields, it lights as though electrified.

Even I can see what it is. The man must understand it better still.

少女の何気ない一撃一撃には、とんでもない程の魔力が籠もっている。
そのあまりにも強い魔力が、触れ合っただけで相手の武具に浸透しているのだ。

pages.en:
It is a violent torrent of magical energy, so intense that the naked eye can perceive it.

Every casual stroke the girl makes contains an absurd quantity of power.

The energy is so concentrated that it floods into her opponent's weapon at the slightest contact.

pages.ja:
あんなもの、受けるだけでも相当な衝撃になる。
男の槍が正確無比な狙撃銃だとしたら、少女の一撃は火力に物を言わせた散弾銃だ。
少女の一撃が振るわれる度に、庭は閃光に包まれる。

pages.en:
Simply receiving such a blow must be a tremendous shock.

If the man's spear is a sniper rifle of flawless precision, the girl's attack is a shotgun that overwhelms through sheer firepower.

Every time she swings, the garden drowns in light.

pages.en:
“Coward! What kind of warrior conceals her own weapon…!?”

He spits the curse while weathering the girl's onslaught.

“…”

She offers no answer, only drives the “something” in her hands at him again…!

pages.ja:
「テメェ……！」
男は反撃もままならず後退する。
なにしろ少女が持つ武器は視えないのだ。
相手の間合いが判らない以上、無闇に攻め込むのは迂闊すぎる。

“You—!”

Unable even to counterattack, the man retreats.

The weapon in the girl's hands is invisible.

With no way to judge her reach, charging blindly would be recklessness itself.

But without knowing its shape or length, there is nothing to see.

Perhaps the weapon itself is transparent. Even when it scatters sparks, no outline emerges.

For the first time, a sound escapes the girl.

The arm wielding that invisible “something” grows fiercer.

An unbroken dance of the sword, falling like torrential rain.

The scattering sparks recall iron glowing in a forge.

He may be the man who nearly killed me, but I cannot help admiring him.

Faced with a weapon he cannot see, he reads nothing but the movement of the girl's arms and the placement of her feet—and blocks her with perfect certainty…!

“Hnh—!”

But his defense carries him no farther.

As if declaring that an enemy driven onto the defensive need not be cut down, only crushed, the girl steps still deeper into his guard—

and brings down a blow with every ounce of her strength…!

“Don't get carried away, fool—!”

Perhaps he sees his chance, because the man vanishes.

No—he leaps backward with such speed that he seems to disappear.

The girl's blow cleaves empty air with a roar, smashes the earth, and flings clods of soil into the night.

The strike she meant as the finishing blow is evaded with contemptuous ease…!

今までのような無駄のない一撃ならいざ知らず、勝負を決めにかかった大振りでは男を捉える事はできない。

“Idiot! What is she doing…!?”

Even from here, I understand.

Her earlier strokes were stripped of all waste. But a swing that large, thrown in pursuit of a decisive blow, could never catch him.

He endured it all and drove his protesting legs into that one leap.

Because he recognized her blow as the opening that would decide the battle…!

“Ha—!”

The man lands several meters away and springs forward in the same instant.

Like a wall jump in reverse, he retraces his own flight and hurls himself at the girl.

She, meanwhile, still has her sword buried in the earth.
